resolution.note: Out of KRN-only scope (memory:krn-only-scope); evaluating Ponytail in an adopter is not KRN development.

title: Evaluate the Ponytail minimal-code ladder in one adopter
body:
Operator 2026-10-29 approved evaluating the Ponytail coding-minimalism ladder (github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail, MIT) as part of the D23 market review. Its published benchmarks are vendor-run; treat them as a hypothesis. Do not install it globally and add no hook trust (D7/D28 keep KRN-adjacent policy repository-local).
Acceptance: in one adopting repository, add the seven-line decision ladder to the worker brief quality bar for a fixed set of comparable tasks and compare against the current briefs on lines changed, review rounds, BLOCKING findings, escaped defects, tokens and cost per merged PR; record the result and a keep or drop decision. No plugin install, global instructions or new tracker features.
